Three tags drop in:
Dirt and debris
Ball fuzz
Shifting sand
Three things wear a padel court down. Dirt and leaves settle into the sand. Ball felt mixes in and makes the surface slick. And footwork pushes sand to the walls, leaving the middle under-sanded.

Every 3-4 months: turf deep clean + sand top-up
Every 6 months if lightly used
Outdoors: blow leaves every 1-2 weeks
A court needs a turf deep clean and a sand top-up every three to four months, or every six if it's lightly used. Outdoors, blow leaves off every one to two weeks.
